mainEntity.name: What safety considerations are important for appliance installation in the East Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Safety is paramount for appliance installation, particularly regarding electrical and gas connections which must comply with local codes in the East Bay area. We ensure all installations are performed by licensed professionals who adhere to current safety standards and building regulations. Proper ventilation for certain appliances, secure anchoring to prevent tipping, and correct utility hookups are critical aspects we oversee to guarantee safe operation post-installation. This compliance protects your property and occupants.
